name: copilot-desktop-community
description: A standalone, community-driven desktop client for Microsoft Copilot, designed for a more integrated and flexible user experience.

scripts.postbuild: rm -rf "/Applications/Copilot Desktop CE.app" && cp -R dist/mac*/"Copilot Desktop CE.app" /Applications/

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Copilot Desktop CE uses your microphone for voice conversations with Copilot.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Copilot Desktop CE may use your camera for video features in Copilot.
